name: Channels read on every device
author: wizard
description: How far you have read each channel (and General) is kept on your box, so reading a channel to the bottom on the desktop clears it on the phone too, within about 30 seconds. Needs Channels in Chats and a box with the Agent Service read sync (WIZARD_CHANNEL_READ_SYNC=1); otherwise each device keeps its own (wizard-agent-service issue 471).
